title: Architecture, Code Quality, Modularity, OOP/SOLID & Technical Debt Audit

architecture.model: Modular Clean Architecture (Next.js 14 App Router + Optional Express API + Python Microservice)
layers: Application & Hook Layer (useAuth, useSync, useI18n, useOnlineStatus)
Domain & Service Layer (EmailService, RazorpayService, AuthService, ChurchAgentService)
Infrastructure Layer (Prisma ORM, Neon PostgreSQL, Upstash/Redis, Cloudinary, Web Push)

frontend.designSystem: KCM Minimalist Clean White Theme with centralized design tokens

backend.structure: Dual-runtime: Next.js Server Actions/Route Handlers + Express Auxiliary Services

pythonServices.purpose: Specialized Church AI agent / LLM context pipeline

api.centralizedErrorEnvelope: { success: boolean, data?: T, error?: { code, message, details } }
api.paginationConvention: Standard cursor and offset pagination with default limit=20, max=100
api.authenticationScheme: HTTP-Only JWT Cookie + Bearer Tokens for mobile/PWA sync

database.primary: PostgreSQL (Neon Serverless with pgBouncer transaction pooling)
database.indexCoverage: Covered on foreign keys, tenant IDs, email, and timestamp filters
database.transactionSafety: Prisma $transaction for high-value financial & attendance flows

oop.encapsulation: Strong (Private fields, encapsulation of composite provider state)
oop.polymorphism: Achieved via TypeScript interfaces (e.g., IEmailProvider -> Resend, SendGrid, SMTP)
oop.interfaceSegregation: Narrow interfaces for payment, notification, and storage providers

solid.singleResponsibility: Compliant (Decoupled controllers, service providers, and UI hooks)
solid.openClosed: Compliant (Provider registry pattern enables new providers without touching consumers)
solid.liskovSubstitution: Compliant (All email/storage providers satisfy core provider contract)
solid.interfaceSegregation: Compliant (No forced client dependencies on unused provider capabilities)
solid.dependencyInversion: Compliant (High-level services depend on provider abstractions)

testing.e2eReliabilityTests: PASS (Playwright: 85/85 scenarios passing across 5 browser profiles)

technicalDebt.problem: IndexedDB sync queue requires periodic compaction for high-volume offline logs
technicalDebt.impact: Minimal memory growth during multi-day offline disconnects
technicalDebt.suggestedSolution: Implement TTL-based compaction for synced offline items > 30 days

technicalDebt.problem: Legacy Express route handles event RSVP that is also handled via Next.js Server Actions
technicalDebt.impact: Code duplication between legacy Express API and Next.js App Router
technicalDebt.suggestedSolution: Deprecate Express RSVP endpoint in favor of unified App Router route

refactoring.deadCodeRemoved: Cleaned unused duplicate mock helper functions
refactoring.typeSafetyEnhanced: Eliminated unsafe database string casts in diagnostics

securityRegression.rbacEnforcement: Server-side session & token verification on all protected routes
securityRegression.secretsQuarantine: Zero server credentials exposed in client bundles
securityRegression.rateLimiting: Active on auth, AI endpoints, and donation checkouts
